note: Urged the organisers to suspend an AI-lab-sponsored event on open research problems, citing risks of low-quality mathematics and burdens on early-career researchers. Since then: a joint statement in late September redesigned the event around new proofs of known results; OpenAI dropped its sponsorship and Anthropic and the organisers parted ways; Tao’s Society for Artificial Intelligence Research and XTX Markets stepped in. The revamped event is planned for mid-November (Quanta, 22 October).
title: Open Letter about the Mathathon
who: Members of the Caltech community and research mathematicians (771 signatories at publication)
